description: Shortlist creative AI tools, models and hosts for something the user wants to make (pictures, video, voice, music, talking presenters, 3D). Returns the best matches with a plain-English summary, whether it is open or closed, whether there is a free option, the cheapest paid plan, and links. Ordered by how well each matches the task; nobody pays for placement.

budget.description: Most the user will pay per month, in US dollars. 0 means free options only. Leave out for any price.

commercial_use.description: Optional: true to keep only entries whose terms allow commercial use of what you make (including with conditions or on paid plans).

open_source.description: true: only open-source or downloadable (open-weights) entries. false: only closed ones. Leave out for both.

task.description: What the user wants to make or do, in plain words, e.g. "turn a photo into a short video" or "clone my voice for a podcast".

type.description: Optional: tool = an app you sign up to; model = the engine (often downloadable); host = a service that runs other makers' models.

name: find_tool
title: Find creative AI tools for a task
